
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # read_csv and mutate
library(lme4)       # lmer
library(emmeans)    # emmeans and pairs
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(performance)
library(modelsummary)
library(lmerTest)

df_long4 <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study3.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task_explanation_group), ref = "predict"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "color"),
    color_high = relevel(factor(color_high), ref = "Y"),
    feet_high = relevel(factor(feet_high), ref = "C")
  )
```

```{r}
contrasts(df_long4$task) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

levels(df_long4$task)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1|participant),
  data = df_long4
)
summary(model_eff)
```
```{r}
emmeans(model_eff, pairwise ~ task)
```


```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_relevance * task)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_dimension * task)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```

```{r}
plot_df <- df_long4 %>%
  group_by(task, feature_dimension) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean,
    color = task,
    group = task
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = .3),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    position = position_dodge(width = .3)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean - se,
      ymax = mean + se
    ),
    width = .15,
    position = position_dodge(width = .3)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Feature Dimension",
    y = "feature_importance",
    color = "Task"
  )
```

plot_df <- df_long4 %>%

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ task * feature_dimension)

contrast(
  emm,
  interaction = "pairwise",
  by = NULL
)
```

```{r}
emm_rel <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ task | feature_dimension)

pairs(emm_rel)

emm_rel <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ task | feature_relevance)

pairs(emm_rel)
```

```{r}
emmip(model_eff,
      task ~ feature_dimension,
      CIs = TRUE)
```
